title: Decision: a leaf cannot switch between did_webvh and another credential type in an Update or UpdatePath
description:
draft-atwood-mls-didwebvh-credential-00 §Successor Credentials defines when a did_webvh credential is a valid successor of an earlier did_webvh credential (same SCID, earlier log a prefix of the new). RFC 9420 §5.3.1 leaves the replacement check to the application. The draft does not say whether a leaf may switch between did_webvh and another credential type (basic, x509) in an Update or UpdatePath.

Readings: (a) any switch is allowed (the application's AS decides); (b) no switch: a did_webvh leaf can only be replaced by a did_webvh successor, and a basic leaf cannot become did_webvh in place.

Chosen: (b). Switching away from did_webvh would let a leaf drop out of the record's authorization rule while keeping its place; switching to it changes the identity (the SCID) of an existing leaf. A device that wants a did_webvh credential leaves and joins again. mimi-mls didwebvh.rs did_leaves (DidWebvhError::NotASuccessor); test didwebvh_rogue.rs a_forked_credential_is_not_a_successor. For -01: say explicitly.
